title: Add steward triage pass at the start of each drain (retry vq7x)
summary: Retry of job 20261031-082446-vq7x: after the Hestia/review passes and before the queue is read, each drain makes one steward model call with the focus, open items and recent failure classes, applies returned priorities as steward-authored records within the urgent/high caps, skips person-set items, never closes, and prints one line per change. The earlier failure was a verifier deadline, not a known code defect, so the same work is redone with smaller test scope.

defaults_applied.how: All code and tests are Rust.
Tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/triage.rs; cargo test, clippy -D warnings and fmt must pass.
Criteria run named tests that check records written and drain output.
The check is priorities matching focus within caps, not the existence of a module.
One focused change; no standalone command or prompt file.
Behavior is verified by running the triage tests.
The person-set guard, caps and no-close rule are enforced in code and tested.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs: drain_with (about line 2706) first calls steps.review_passes() (line 2716; Steps impl near line 3299 calls Athena::review_passes) and then reads the queue, so the triage step goes between them as a new Steps method with a default no-op so existing fake Steps in drain.rs tests still compile. No triage code exists yet under crates/ (Grep 'triage' found nothing). Priority records live in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs; any new record field must pass its validation allow-list and the AnyRecord round-trip tests there, so the plan reuses the existing priority record with a steward author and adds no new record kind. The steward role is in crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs and the model fake in crates/athena-agent/src/fake.rs. Behavior is measured by reading the records the drain writes and its printed output in crates/athena-cli/tests/triage.rs, not through a stand-in.

Job 20261031-082446-vq7x was rejected because the verifier hit its 2400s deadline and the `test` check had no output; no code finding was recorded. Addressed by redoing the same change, keeping its 11-file candidate scope as below (candidate discarded, redone from base), with tests focused so the workspace test run stays fast. The verifier-timeout process fix proposed from introspection 20261103-055154-w84m is a different change and out of scope here; the typed request takes precedence.

Dependency: job 20261031-082442-92qg (focus record and urgent/high caps) is assumed landed; the producer reuses its focus reader and cap logic and must not reimplement them. If they are absent from the base, the producer reports that instead of inventing them.
Goal and audience: the Athena operator, who wants queue priorities kept aligned with the current focus without hand-setting them; the verifier judges via the named tests.

The changes in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs made by the earlier candidate are kept only if needed by the triage step (listed as low-probability deliverables).

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test triage`: with a fake triage answer, priority records are written with the steward as author and carrying the one-line reason; the urgent and high caps are not exceeded; an item whose latest priority record was set by a person is unchanged.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test triage`: when the fake triage call fails, the drain prints a triage-failed note, still prints other output, and goes on to work the queue; on success the drain prints exactly one line per applied change.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test triage`: a fake answer proposing to close an item yields a steward work item and no close record for that item.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`; all pass.
Grep of crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs shows the triage call after review_passes and before the queue is read; crates/athena-core/src/triage.rs contains no code path that writes a close record.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the steward triage pass; Grep 'triage' in CHANGELOG.md finds it.

Job 20261031-082446-vq7x is addressed: the same triage work is redone from base; git diff shows only the listed deliverables and no governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows) is changed.

out_of_scope: Work of job 20261031-082442-92qg (focus record, caps, focus command, plan demotion) is kept as is: athena.toml, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/focus.rs, crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs, crates/athena-core/src/store.rs, crates/athena-data/src/config.rs
Changing the caps or the focus command
A new triage prompt file under the prompt sets (token headroom exhausted)
Rewriting priority records set by a person
Editing anything under records/ by hand
Verifier timeout handling and `athena retry` resume (the introspection's proposed process fix)
departures: Lower verification pass than reference: the prior attempt failed a test check and hit a verifier deadline, and the change depends on an unverified job.
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline: the drain gains a model-driven step that writes priority records and is bounded by caps and a person-set guard.
